about: Havenbrooke's factions in play (dungeon/factions.py, dungeon/jobs.py): drawn from dungeon/world/packages/havenbrooke/factions.json, with clocks and jobs written for play. Drafts for Vanta to keep, change or cut.

factions.name: Havenbrooke University
factions.summary: The university on the east bank: five platforms, five thousand students, and a Dean of Student Life who reads the Oracle first thing.
goals: Keep its students alive, enrolled and out of the papers
Keep the DED and the Crane money happy

clocks.name: Phi Sigma Nox administrative review
clocks.done: The university puts Phi Sigma Nox on probation after its review: no parties for a term, and a Crane on the phone to the president the same afternoon.

jobs.title: Cover a floor
jobs.hook: Residence Life needs someone to cover an RA's rounds on North Dorm Ridge for three nights.
jobs.truth: The RA is not sick. She is in Evermere after a feed went wrong, and the office wants it kept quiet.
jobs.missed: Nobody walked the floor, and a fight on the fourth floor went on for an hour before security came.

jobs.title: A pull from the basement archives
jobs.hook: A professor needs a box of 1984 integration files pulled from the library basement and copied before Friday.
jobs.truth: The box holds Whitestone's notes on the group she tried to found in 1984, and the reason it was shut down.
jobs.missed: The files went back unread, and the professor found someone else who was not so careful with them.

factions.name: City of Haven
factions.summary: The city government and Haven PD, whose long arrangement with the university and the Cranes is mostly about who does not call whom.
goals: Keep town and gown from fighting

clocks.name: The West Haven noise ordinance
clocks.done: The city council passes the West Haven noise ordinance: house parties on Elm and Birch end at midnight, and Haven PD starts writing tickets to the tenants by name.

jobs.title: Flyers for the mayor
jobs.hook: The mayor's re-election office pays cash for anyone who will paper the campus with flyers before the vote.
jobs.truth: The flyers were printed at a shop owned by a Crane company, and the opposing candidate knows it.
jobs.missed: The flyers stayed in their boxes, and the campaign office remembers who took the money.

factions.name: The Crane family
factions.summary: The vampire family on the ridge above Haven since 1819: two scholarships a year, a seat on the Council of Bloodlines and a steward who answers the phone.
goals: Keep Vivienne on the diplomatic track

clocks.name: Scholarships frozen
clocks.done: The Crane scholarships are frozen "pending review", and two mundane sophomores get letters saying their spring tuition is now their own.

clocks.name: The older sealskin
clocks.done: A sealskin from the Crane collection turns up in a Boston auction catalog, and a selkie family in Maine recognizes the markings.

jobs.title: Staff the Crane gala
jobs.hook: The Crane steward is hiring students to pour and carry at the family's fall gala on the ridge, cash, discretion expected.
jobs.truth: The gala is where the family decides whose scholarships survive the year, and the staff hear more than the guests.
jobs.missed: The gala went on without the help, and Mr. Vale does not ask twice.

factions.name: Sigma Theta Hex
factions.summary: The witch sorority off Lantern Way, with custody of the great ring in Vespers Hall and alumnae in three senators' offices.
goals: Mastery of the campus ley lines

clocks.name: The ritual-leadership suite
clocks.done: Sigma Theta Hex names its ritual-leadership suite for next year, and the name on the letter is a surprise to everyone, including the sister who got it.

jobs.title: Prepare the equinox ring
jobs.hook: Sigma Theta Hex needs the great ring in Vespers Hall cleaned, salted and chalked before the equinox, by hands that are not a sister's.
jobs.truth: Someone scratched a break into the ring last week. Whoever prepares it will either find it or be blamed for it.
jobs.missed: The ring went unprepared, and the rite was moved, and the sisters know whose name was on the sign-up sheet.

factions.name: Alpha Gamma
factions.summary: The lycan-heavy fraternity on the north edge of campus: a chosen family, full-moon ceremonies in the basement and the Harvest Howl every Halloween.
goals: A chosen family for brothers who need one

clocks.name: Leadership challenge
clocks.done: Alpha Gamma holds its leadership vote, and the house has a new president by midnight and a hole in the common-room wall by one.

jobs.title: Set up the Harvest Howl
jobs.hook: Alpha Gamma needs hands to build the Howl bonfire on the north fields and string the lights before Saturday.
jobs.truth: The permit from the university was never filed, and someone in the house is hoping it gets noticed.
jobs.missed: The bonfire went up crooked and late, and the brothers know who said they would help.

factions.name: The Havenbrooke Oracle
factions.summary: The weekly student paper in the Thornewall basement, mundane-majority, with an editor who prints what costs someone something.

clocks.name: The exposure-fatigue story
clocks.done: The Oracle runs its exposure-fatigue story on the front page, with numbers from Evermere that nobody was supposed to have.

jobs.title: Photos for the Oracle
jobs.hook: The Oracle needs photos of the Senate budget hearing, and a second pair of ears in the room.
jobs.truth: The budget moves money from the Kindling pilot into a Phi Sigma Nox heritage fund, and nobody plans to say so out loud.
jobs.missed: The Oracle ran the story without the photos, and got a number wrong that the Senate will not let it forget.

factions.name: The Department of Esoteric Development
factions.summary: The federal body that licenses, inspects, prosecutes and hires: the biggest single employer of Havenbrooke graduates.
goals: Keep the Esoteric Development Code enforced

clocks.name: Feeding-scandal review
clocks.done: The DED announces a federal review of feeding consent on three campuses, Havenbrooke first, and the field office in Syracuse starts taking statements.

jobs.title: A day at the field office
jobs.hook: The DED field office wants student volunteers to sit in on intake interviews for a week, for a line on the resume.
jobs.truth: One of the intake files is about someone on the third floor of Nexus.
jobs.missed: The volunteer slot went to someone else, who read the file.

factions.name: The Corwin lineage
factions.summary: A Boston witch family with three senators, a federal judge and a ritual consultancy, and a daughter at Havenbrooke not doing what was planned.

clocks.name: The family plan
clocks.done: Genevieve Corwin books a suite at Harper's for the weekend and sends the dinner invitation to the whole third floor.

factions.name: House Aelhwynn
factions.summary: A fae house that runs on betrothals and aesthetic compliance, with an oak registered as part of its daughter.
goals: See Rina married to Callum Ashveil
Keep the grove and its alliance

clocks.name: The betrothal comes due
clocks.done: House Aelhwynn sets a date. The invitations are printed on bark paper and delivered by hand, and one arrives at Nexus Unit B.
